finding: G1: default asynchronous signal could interrupt RNG/state/output transaction and overstate snapshot/count validity.
changes: generate_files installs main-thread SIGINT/SIGTERM handlers that only store a stop flag; previous handlers are restored after completion or failure capture.

Stop checks occur between complete records. An in-flight draw/state/hash/charge update and observation/truth/journal/full-query/checkpoint writes finish before all streams are flushed and SourceStopped is raised.
Failure capture reconstructs the last complete source state from a preserved208-byte journal record; an in-progress live source is never serialized as a valid snapshot.

An unavoidable fault inside a scalar RNG/state transaction reports noise_draws_generated:null, noise_draws_exact:false, and explicit lower/upper bounds. Complete returned transactions retain exact counts even if a subsequent I/O operation fails.
Failure metadata includes last complete index, output flush cursor, persisted binary record/trailing-byte counts, signal identity/count and an explicitly unvalidated live cursor.
Output writes now reject short or invalid write counts. Canonical record/journal/snapshot formats and successful generate_files return fields remain compatible.

API.generate_files_signature: unchanged; invoke in worker main thread
API.SourceStopped: SourceError subclass with .signum; cooperative stop preserves failure.json then propagates a nonzero worker result
API.failure_next_index: last complete record/output boundary, matching source_snapshot; not an inferred interrupted live cursor
API.runner_requirement: Preserve null/unknown counts on unavoidable faults; never coerce missing or unknown draws to0. Hard kills may produce no capture and must remain unknown.
API.receipt_freeze: Generator source hash changed; create manifests and executable receipt only after root final freeze.

limitations: SIGKILL/process death and failing storage cannot guarantee a failure artifact; supervisor must retain uncertainty. No redraw, retry, trajectory replay or original319-draw suite rerun was performed.
